_note: The shape of the operator's targets.json for handoff.mjs --pass targeted --targets <file> (owner 2026-09-30, H8). One entry per skeleton file, one per field path: axis is one of door, arena, cadence, four-question (the four the 2026-09-23 round scored on; a fifth is not added without a ruling), beat is the operator's one sentence on what the current line fails on that axis, written from the read (the analysis's per-field notes and the owner's notes). The beat never quotes the line: the current sentence is withheld, and the reuse check blocks a four-word run of it. The cases below are the 2026-09-23 round's own.

ledger[2].beat: the outside door must open on the reader's own act in the moment and land on what others see or pay; the current line opens from the other side of the table

function.advise_catalyst.beat: 35 to 45 words, the smallest action last, no sentence over twenty words; the current line ends on its largest action

function.definition_catalyst.beat: the field must carry Water's chemistry somewhere in it (flow, current, banks); the current line names none

gifts[6].beat: the chip must name a symptom the reader would catch themselves doing, not a virtue an admirer would name; the current chip is a virtue
